name: flowtrace
description: AI 友好的研发项目进度管理工具

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowtrace/shared && npm run build -w @flowtrace/mcp && npm run build -w @flowtrace/backend && npm run build -w @flowtrace/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @flowtrace/backend" "npm run dev -w @flowtrace/web"
scripts.test: npm run build -w @flowtrace/shared && npm run test -w @flowtrace/backend && npm run test -w @flowtrace/mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @flowtrace/shared && npm run build -w @flowtrace/mcp && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
